veranderings.voor: Só werk sy reg op 'n naam
veranderings.na: Só word sy reg op 'n naam erken
veranderings.rede: 'n Reg 'werk' nie in Afrikaans nie (calque of 'that is how his right works'); registration is how the right is recognised, which keeps the meaning and the length.

veranderings.blok: Die reg op gesondheid en op kos
veranderings.rede: The point is being more prone to illness, which Afrikaans says idiomatically as 'makliker siek word'; 'gouer' reads as 'sooner'.
